groups.text: The LCD screen will be used for all display needs.
Go with plastic for the case.
The design should use five buttons and one integrated scroll-wheel push-button.
The integrated button should have three functions: Up, Down, and Okay.
The power button will be integrated, and the separate power button is dropped.
Power source decision unresolved due to conflicting inputs on hand dynamo vs battery.
Budget is tight and funds are limited, risking the ability to include all desired features.
No physical buttons available to meet the design requirement.
PM will write the report detailing all decisions made so far.
All participants will enter the questionnaire.
